articles.headline: CMS targets 340B, site-neutral rates in 2027 outpatient rule — 8 things to know
articles.summary: CMS's proposed 2027 outpatient prospective payment rule targets two major revenue streams simultaneously: reduced 340B drug reimbursement rates and an expanded site-neutral payment policy covering new categories of outpatient services. The combined effect would strip billions from hospital outpatient revenue starting in 2027, with the eight-point breakdown detailing affected service categories, policy mechanics, and the regulatory rationale driving each change.
articles.why_it_matters: These dual cuts represent among the largest structural reimbursement risks in the coverage universe, with cascading effects on hospital system financials, M&A dynamics in outpatient care, and payer-provider contract negotiations.
